subject: project:gdl
value: R71 removes one WebFrank rule through a natural source change and narrows two remaining investigations without claiming source impossibility. InitControls is raw exact at 27/27 instructions on unchanged stock GC/1.2.5 flags after reusing the existing clear_pad_levels helper. The controller-pad experiment reproduces every rule-controlled instruction choice through inlining but leaves a 24-versus-32-byte frame; its rule remains. Texture SDK types and finite natural-source controls do not close the two argument-materialization swaps; its rules remain. A separate diagnostic repair stops retired postprocessor artifacts from masquerading as current compiler output. These results demonstrate that source/inlining context can explain some apparent compiler walls, not that every postprocessor can yet be retired.
